title: Data table 1 from rem:b1-current-status
html:
Layer Status Discharger
Inclusion \tau_{\mathrm{arch}}(G^{(n)}) \subseteq \mathcal{P}_n, all n theorem regulator definition
Soft sharpness, all n, Bring-natural F theorem Soft sharpness of the depth correspondence is theorem-level — via Borel + polylog non-vanishing (Borel + Lewin)
Strong sharpness, depth 2, any F theorem Depth-2 identification of G^{(2)}(\mathcal{H}_q) with K_3^{\mathrm{ind}}(F) \otimes \mathbb{Q} (Bloch–Suslin)
figure-8 row theorem The depth correspondence is theorem-level at the figure-8 row (Bloch--Suslin + Murakami--Murakami) (+ Murakami–Murakami 2001)
7 torus-knot rows theorem The depth correspondence is theorem-level at the torus-knot rows (Bloch--Suslin + Garoufalidis--Lê) (+ Garoufalidis–Lê 2005)
Borromean row theorem The depth correspondence conditionally reduces to the Volume Conjecture at Borromean rings (+ van der Veen 2008)
Whitehead row theorem The depth correspondence conditionally reduces to the Volume Conjecture at Borromean rings (+ Murakami 2002)
Hecke-Baer- at generic q* theorem Iwahori--Hecke algebra H_n(q) is a Baer-*-ring at generic q (+ exact failure locus)
Bridge map at n \leq 4 theorem Two-filtration bridge map verified at small partitions (n \leq 4)
Joint Galois \times braid action, all cells theorem Joint motivic-Galois \times braid action commutes on every bi-filtration cell — discharged
\mathrm{Im}\,\mathrm{Li}_3(\zeta_5) = 4\pi^{3}/125 theorem Trilogarithm imaginary part at \zeta_5
\mathrm{Cl}_3(2\pi/5) + \mathrm{Cl}_3(4\pi/5) = -(12/25)\zeta(3) theorem Cl_3(2\pi/5) + Cl_3(4\pi/5) = -(12/25)\zeta(3)
Jones-faithfulness \le 10 crossings theorem Bring-embeddable Jones-faithfulness: theorem at crossing \leq 10, falsified for Conway-KT at crossing 11 (HTW 1998)
chiral hyperbolic rows (5_2, 6_2, 6_3) conditional theorem — the per-knot VC leg is discharged; what remains open is the depth-3 Chern–Simons partner [ohtsuki2016-52], [ohtsuki-yokota-6crossings]; depth-3 open
chiral hyperbolic rows (beyond 6_3) conditional theorem modulo per-knot VC open knot-by-knot
Cl_3(2π/5) − Cl_3(4π/5) closed form open — single real number \approx 0.955 reflection + multiplication formulas exhausted
Strong sharpness, depth 3 over \mathbb{Q}(\zeta_5) conditional on Goncharov \zeta_5 sub-case Goncharov's depth-3 conjecture at \mathbb{Q}(\zeta_5) (either route)
Strong sharpness, depth \ge 3 over arbitrary F conjectural Beilinson + Goncharov (external)
Strong sharpness, depth \ge 4 conjectural Beilinson + Goncharov (external)
Geometric realisation of Cl_3(2π/5) open, 3 candidates Geometric realisation of \mathrm{Cl}_3(2\pi/5) as a Bring-natural depth-3 invariant
Bridge map at n \geq 5 partitions open extends the bar-class argument
